Strategy: Big items go loose, small items go tight. A large item crammed into the tightest bin leaves a dead leftover, while the loosest bin still has room, so spend loose capacity on big items and save tight bins for later. Score by residual when the item is at least half the loosest residual, else Best Fit, so ranking can switch only for big items. It may help by preserving tight bins, but may fail by stranding loose bins empty.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    big = item * 2 >= max(bins)
    return [r if big else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Size-conditional: worst-fit when item*2 >= max residual, else Best Fit.
